angular-momentum.def: The rotational partner of momentum. For a rigid object turning about a fixed axis, L = Iω, in kg·m²/s; its sign gives the direction of turning.

point-angular-momentum.def: For a point object moving past a chosen point, L = rmv sin θ: its momentum times the perpendicular distance from the point to its line of motion. It depends on the point chosen.

angular-impulse.def: A torque times the time it acts, τΔt (the area under a torque-time graph), in N·m·s. It equals the change in angular momentum: τΔt = ΔL.
